query: 2025年Q3季度订单量是多少
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_date d ON o.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025 AND d.quarter='Q3'
generated_sql:
SELECT SUM(fo.order_quantity) AS total_order_quantity
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.quarter = 'Q3'
  AND fo.date_id BETWEEN 20250701 AND 20250930;

query: 华中大区一共有多少笔订单

generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id WHERE dr.region_name = '华中';

query: 品牌优衣库总共卖了多少件
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(o.order_quantity) FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id=p.product_id WHERE p.brand='优衣库'
generated_sql: SELECT SUM(o.order_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM fact_order o INNER JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.brand = '优衣库'

query: 各大区订单量占比是多少
expected_sql: SELECT r.region_name,ROUND(COUNT(o.order_id)*100.0/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order),2) FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON o.region_id=r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    r.region_name AS 大区,
    ROUND(COUNT(f.order_id) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(f.order_id)) OVER (), 2) AS 订单量占比
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY 订单量占比 DESC;

query: 总销量超过1400件的品牌有哪些
expected_sql: SELECT p.brand FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY p.brand HAVING SUM(o.order_quantity)>1400
generated_sql: SELECT d.brand FROM dim_product d JOIN fact_order f ON d.product_id = f.product_id GROUP BY d.brand HAVING SUM(f.order_quantity) > 1400

query: 各省份各品类的销售额

query: 帮我算一下2025年1月份的GMV
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(order_amount) FROM fact_order WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250131
generated_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(fo.order_amount) * 100, 2) AS GMV_percentage
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025 AND dd.month = 1;

query: 4月份各品类销售额占比
expected_sql: SELECT p.category,ROUND(SUM(o.order_amount)*100.0/(SELECT SUM(order_amount) FROM fact_order WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20250401 AND 20250430),2) FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id=p.product_id WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20250401 AND 20250430 GROUP BY p.category
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    dp.category,
    ROUND(SUM(fo.order_amount) * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(fo.order_amount)) OVER (), 2) AS sales_ratio
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025 AND dd.month = 4
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY sales_ratio DESC;

FROM fact_order f

query: 5月和11月都下过单的客户有多少位
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM fact_order WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20250501 AND 20250531) a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM fact_order WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20251101 AND 20251130) b ON a.customer_id=b.customer_id
generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM (
    SELECT fo.customer_id
    FROM fact_order fo
    JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
    WHERE dd.year = 2025 AND dd.month IN (5, 11)
    GROUP BY fo.customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dd.month) = 2
) AS t;

query: 2月比7月多了多少销售额
